name: pilot-release-candidate
purpose: Bundle provider-independently verified development work into a release candidate without invoking deployment.

rules.ready: READY only when every included source package has a passing provider-independent verification result
rules.blocked: Any required verification failure blocks the release candidate
rules.deployment: Creating or validating a release candidate must not invoke the deployment adapter
rules.approval_boundary: Deployment may begin only after explicit APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE promotion
